decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Details of the positioning of all internal doors to be retained be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - The, the subject of this consent, shall not be carried out before planning permission has been granted for the use of the building as a hostel for the the homeless and a contract for the carrrying out of the works to effect the use has been let.
description: Internal alterations in connection with proposed change of use (Listed Buidling Consent)
